**GIVEN:**

( cottheta - 1)over( 1- tantheta) ÷ ( (sintheta)/((1 +costheta)) + ( (1 + costheta))/(sintheta) )

**FORMULA USED:**

 cottheta = costheta /sintheta. 

tantheta = sintheta/costheta.

sin²theta + cos² theta = 1.

( a + b)² = a² + b² +2ab.

**CALCULATION:**

costheta/sintheta -1over1- sintheta/costheta ÷ (sin² theta +( 1+ costheta)²)over( 1+costheta) sintheta

⇒( costheta - sintheta)over sintheta × costheta over ( costheta - sintheta) ÷ ( sin² theta + 1 + cos²theta + 2 costheta) over sintheta( 1+ costheta) 

⇒ costheta over sintheta ÷ ( 2+ 2 costheta )over sintheta ( 1+ costheta) 

⇒ costheta over sintheta ÷ 2 ( 1+ costheta)over sintheta ( 1+ costheta) 

⇒ costheta over sintheta × sintheta over 2 = costheta over2. 

**Hence, the value is costhetaover2.** .
